form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Moran (for himself, Mr. Boozman, and Mrs. Blackburn) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs

form.official-title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to impose limitations on the provision of critical skill incentives to employees of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Senior Executive Services positions, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Stop Government Rewards Enriching Executives in the District Act of 2024 or the Stop GREED Act of 2024.

section.header: Limitations on provision of incentives for critical skills to Senior Executive Service employees of Department of Veterans Affairs
section.text: Section 706(d) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: A critical skill incentive may not be provided under paragraph (1) to an employee of the Department employed in a Senior Executive Service position (or equivalent position) whose position is based out of the central office of the Department, regardless of the actual location where the employee performs the functions of the position.

A critical skill incentive provided under paragraph (1) to an employee of the Department employed in a Senior Executive Service position (or equivalent position) not described in subparagraph (A) may only be provided—

clause.text: on an individual basis and may not be provided to a group of such employees; and

subclause.text: the Under Secretary for Benefits, the Under Secretary for Health, or the Under Secretary for Memorial Affairs;
the Director of the Office of Management or the Chief Financial Officer;
the Assistant Secretary for Accountability and Whistleblower Protection; and

subparagraph.text: Not less frequently than once each quarter, the Secretary shall submit to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs of the Senate and the Committee on Veterans' Affairs of the House of Representatives a quarterly report on the employees of the Department employed in a Senior Executive Service position (or equivalent position) who were provided a critical skill incentive under paragraph (1).
In this paragraph, the term Senior Executive Service position has the meaning given such term in section 3132(a) of title 5.
